reference_state: removed PTM levels set to 1.0; deltas set to 0.0
interpretation: A positive nonadditive_joint_reliance value means that jointly resetting both PTM classes reduced the fitted model's AUROC more than the sum of resetting each class separately.
scope: This is a model-level joint-reliance contrast on one held-out split. It does not establish causal biological PTM crosstalk.
